narrative.overview: LongPathFix is a native Windows desktop utility rendered inside Tauri 2 + WebView2, designed around the precision and restraint of Windows Terminal, Task Manager, and Sysinternals tooling. Because users arrive with failing backups, broken ZIP extractions, or stalled cloud syncs—and because every rename touches real paths on disk—the interface replaces decorative marketing chrome with immediate diagnostic clarity: a fixed navigation rail, crisp `1px` hairline structural rules, tabular UTF-16 path measurements, and a calibrated before/after distribution ruler (`PathGauge`) sitting directly above a high-density findings table.  The system defaults to a low-glare obsidian/slate dark palette (`color-scheme: dark`) and mirrors every surface, hairline, ink, and status token into a high-contrast porcelain light theme (`data-theme="light"`), tracking Windows system preference when set to Auto. Consistent with the native Windows 11 desktop brief, LongPathFix rejects decorative backdrop blur, neon gradients, uppercase eyebrow kickers above headings, and modal interruptions for routine inspection.
keyCharacteristics: Native Windows 11 `operate` workspace with persistent `224px` left rail (`--rail-width`) and full-viewport `100vh` scroll-contained layout.
Dual-theme CSS custom properties (`[data-theme="dark"]` and `[data-theme="light"]`) built around neutral slate/porcelain tiers and a single Windows Cobalt primary accent.
Calibrated UTF-16 code-unit measurement everywhere paths appear, pairing `Cascadia Mono` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.
Tonal layering and `1px` hairline borders at rest; drop shadows appear strictly on floating popovers and focus-trapped modals.
Full keyboard operation, global `:focus-visible` rings, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, and `aria-live` progress/status announcements.

rules.name: The One Primary Accent Rule
rules.body: Cobalt (`--accent`) marks only primary actions, selection, active checkboxes, and progress; semantic colors (emerald, amber, crimson) never replace cobalt on primary workflow buttons, and cobalt never signals severity.

rules.name: The Tinted Ink Pairing Rule
rules.body: Colored status labels (`--ok-text`, `--warn-text`, `--danger-text`, `--accent-text`) always pair with their translucent `--*-tint` and `--*-border` tokens on neutral surfaces so every badge and banner maintains >= 6.3:1 contrast in both dark and light modes.

rules.name: The Tabular Measurement Rule
rules.body: Every numeric counter, length delta, bucket tally, and timestamp applies `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so scanning down columns and updating live scan counts never shifts horizontal alignment.

rules.name: The Honest Monospace Rule
rules.body: `Cascadia Mono` is reserved strictly for filesystem paths, UTF-16 code-unit lengths, registry keys, batch IDs, and keycaps—never as decorative styling on headings or body prose.

rules.name: The First-Viewport Workbench Rule
rules.body: `Scan & Fix` opens directly into interactive scan controls, threshold presets (`259`, `240`, `200`, `Custom`), fix toggles, and the findings container with zero marketing splash or interstitial onboarding.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, tables, rail items, and drawers stay flat at rest, separated by tonal surface steps and `1px` hairlines; shadows appear only when an overlay (`recent-menu`, `RepairPreviewModal`, or `<= 1360px` overlay drawer) breaks out of document flow.

dos: **Do** measure and display every path and filename length in UTF-16 code units with `tabular-nums` (`Cascadia Mono`) so Windows API ceilings (`259`, `240`, `200`, `255`-char segment) remain unambiguous.
**Do** isolate semantic status tokens (`--ok-*`, `--warn-*`, `--danger-*`) to diagnostic states and keep Cobalt (`--accent`) reserved strictly for primary actions, selection, and progress.
**Do** support both `[data-theme="dark"]` and `[data-theme="light"]` tokens across every custom component and verify `>= 4.5:1` text and `>= 3:1` non-text contrast in both themes.
**Do** preserve flat tonal containment (`1px solid var(--border)`) at rest and reserve drop shadows exclusively for popovers and modal/overlay dialogs.
**Do** gate destructive or disk-mutating actions (`Apply Safe Renames`, `Confirm Remove`, `Enable Windows Long Paths`) behind explicit dry-run verification, two-step confirmation, or UAC prompts.
donts: **Don't** add uppercase eyebrows/kickers above headings, decorative gradient text, or `backdrop-filter` glass blur to workbench panels.

**Don't** introduce external icon fonts, emoji icons, or webfont requests; draw UI glyphs within the uniform `24x24` `1.6px`-stroke inline SVG system and use native Windows 11 typography (`Segoe UI Variable` + `Cascadia Mono`).
**Don't** color primary workflow buttons with status colors (`--ok`, `--warn`, `--danger`) or use `--accent` to indicate severity.
**Don't** drop keyboard focus rings (`:focus-visible`), `prefers-reduced-motion` overrides, or screen-reader live regions (`role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`) on scan, repair, or modal flows.
